name: Tech Startup Co-Founder Equity & Role Alignment
place: A quiet conference room at a co-working space
role: You are a prospective technical co-founder discussing vesting schedules and equity split.
speaker: Founder Sam

tasks.goal: State your proposed technical role and key responsibilities
tasks.hint: Outline what you will contribute to the startup.
tasks.done_when: Learner defined their proposed technical role and core responsibilities.

tasks.goal: Discuss equity percentage split between co-founders
tasks.hint: Raise the topic of equity distribution.
tasks.done_when: Learner brought up equity allocation and proposed or discussed equity split percentages.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a 4-year vesting schedule with a 1-year cliff
tasks.hint: Propose standard vesting terms to protect equity.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed a 4-year vesting schedule with a 1-year cliff period.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'provisional'
tasks.hint: Provisional describes an arrangement that is temporary and subject to later revision. Suggest setting a provisional equity split until funding arrives.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'provisional'.

tasks.goal: Clarify IP assignment and pre-existing code ownership
tasks.hint: Ensure clear boundaries on intellectual property.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified IP assignment and ownership of prior software assets.

tasks.goal: Address concerns regarding initial salary vs equity trade-off
tasks.hint: Discuss reduced cash compensation during early funding.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed salary expectations relative to equity compensation in early stages.

tasks.goal: Ask about fundraising milestones and runway expectations
tasks.hint: Inquire about investor timelines and cash runway.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about current runway, valuation, or fundraising targets.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'dilution'
tasks.hint: Dilution means reduction in equity percentage as new shares are issued to investors. Ask about anti-dilution terms.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'dilution'.

tasks.goal: Negotiate board seats and voting rights structure
tasks.hint: Discuss decision-making authority between founders.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed board representation or major voting threshold requirements.

tasks.goal: Set clear boundaries regarding part-time vs full-time commitment
tasks.hint: Specify when you will transition to 100% full-time.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated conditions for transitioning to full-time commitment.

tasks.goal: Propose a co-founder dispute resolution mechanism
tasks.hint: Suggest how deadlocks between equal partners should be resolved.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed a deadlock resolution or mediation mechanism.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'severance'
tasks.hint: Severance refers to compensation or terms provided when an employment or partnership terminates. Discuss severance conditions if a founder leaves early.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'severance'.

tasks.goal: Agree on initial equity split subject to legal review
tasks.hint: Summarize consensus on equity and roles.
tasks.done_when: Learner summarized agreed equity terms subject to legal documentation.

tasks.goal: Confirm timeline for drafting the co-founders agreement
tasks.hint: Ask when legal documents will be prepared.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed on a timeline for drafting the formal co-founders agreement.

tasks.goal: Express enthusiasm for building the company together
tasks.hint: Conclude the discussion on a positive, aligned note.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed optimism and commitment to partnership.

tasks.goal: Outline target launch date for initial product MVP
tasks.hint: State the planned timeline for product release.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified expected MVP launch target date.

tasks.goal: Clarify primary technical stack responsibilities between founders
tasks.hint: Specify backend vs frontend domain division.
tasks.done_when: Learner defined software engineering role boundaries.

tasks.goal: State current personal financial runway and monthly burn allowance
tasks.hint: Share personal runway expectations.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated personal financial runway before requiring salary.

tasks.goal: Confirm schedule for quarterly co-founder performance check-ins
tasks.hint: Agree on periodic founder alignment reviews.
tasks.done_when: Learner scheduled quarterly co-founder review sessions.

tasks.goal: Verify initial legal entity jurisdiction for incorporation
tasks.hint: Confirm state or country of incorporation.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed incorporation state or legal jurisdiction.

tasks.goal: Confirm cap table tracking tool chosen for share issuance
tasks.hint: Agree on share register platform.
tasks.done_when: Learner selected digital cap table management tool.

tasks.goal: Ask for draft copy of intellectual property assignment agreement
tasks.hint: Request legal document for IP transfer.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested formal IP assignment documentation draft.

tasks.goal: Confirm voting procedure for adding future co-founders or executives
tasks.hint: Agree on supermajority approval requirements.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed on voting threshold for adding new equity partners.

tasks.goal: Agree on formal corporate title designations for public launch
tasks.hint: Finalize CEO, CTO, or founder titles.
tasks.done_when: Learner finalized executive title designations.

tasks.goal: Confirm next meeting date with startup legal counsel
tasks.hint: Set appointment with company attorney.
tasks.done_when: Learner scheduled follow-up session with startup lawyer.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'cliff'
tasks.hint: Cliff refers to initial vesting waiting period. Discuss the one-year cliff term.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'cliff'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'valuation'
tasks.hint: Valuation means company monetary worth estimate. Discuss seed funding valuation targets.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'valuation'.

tasks.goal: Negotiate keeping your full equity share if the company is sold
tasks.hint: Propose that all your unvested shares convert immediately if the company is acquired by another firm.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated keeping full equity share if the company is sold.

tasks.goal: Clarify ownership rights of side projects built outside work hours
tasks.hint: Define IP exclusion scope for personal projects.
tasks.done_when: Learner established clear IP boundaries for non-competing side projects.
tasks.scene_hint: Laptop fans whir softly in a quiet co-working conference room.

tasks.goal: Propose monthly stipend cap during pre-revenue development phase
tasks.hint: Suggest modest living expense allowance.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed capped expense stipend prior to venture funding.
tasks.scene_hint: A steaming coffee mug sits next to pitch deck slide printouts on the glass table.

tasks.goal: Inquire how personal capital contributions will be treated on cap table
tasks.hint: Ask if founder cash investment is debt or equity.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified accounting for personal cash invested in company.
tasks.scene_hint: Notifications chime on a smartphone screen showing investor calendar invites.

tasks.goal: Discuss equity buyback terms if a founder leaves voluntarily
tasks.hint: Negotiate company repurchasing unvested shares.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated unvested share repurchase provisions upon departure.
tasks.scene_hint: Mechanical keyboard switches clack while editing financial forecast spreadsheets.

tasks.goal: Set clear guidelines for advisory board equity allocations
tasks.hint: Limit advisor share pool percentage.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed standard advisor equity grant limits.
tasks.scene_hint: A framed tech conference badge hangs on the wall behind the desk.

tasks.goal: Propose equal splitting of patent application filing expenses
tasks.hint: Share initial IP protection costs.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed sharing legal costs for patent applications.
tasks.scene_hint: Faint ambient music plays in the background of the incubator space.

tasks.goal: Clarify non-compete clause duration after founder exit
tasks.hint: Negotiate reasonable post-employment restrictions.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated non-compete period and geographical scope.
tasks.scene_hint: A projector hums quietly while displaying cap table scenario models.

tasks.goal: Discuss key person insurance policies for founding team
tasks.hint: Inquire about insurance protecting company against founder loss.
tasks.done_when: Learner raised key person life insurance coverage options.
tasks.scene_hint: Desk lamps illuminate notebook sketches of software wireframes.

tasks.goal: Establish protocol for handling external consulting inquiries
tasks.hint: Agree on rules for outside paid speaking or consulting.
tasks.done_when: Learner established guidelines for outside consulting activities.
tasks.scene_hint: A smart display shows real-time website analytics for the beta launch page.

tasks.goal: Propose standard 10 percent employee stock option pool reservation
tasks.hint: Allocate equity for early key hires.
tasks.done_when: Learner proposed setting aside an option pool for future team members.
tasks.scene_hint: Acronyms and financial formulas fill the side margin of a legal notepad.

tasks.goal: Clarify whether founder departure is classified as for-cause or without-cause
tasks.hint: Define bad leaver vs good leaver terms.
tasks.done_when: Learner defined good leaver and bad leaver equity repurchase terms.

tasks.goal: Explain why technical debt remediation requires dedicated sprint cycles
tasks.hint: Argue for engineering quality over fast feature delivery.
tasks.done_when: Learner justified allocating development time to platform refactoring.

tasks.goal: Dispute proposed unequal equity split based on prior idea creation
tasks.hint: Argue that execution value outweighs initial concept.
tasks.done_when: Learner challenged unequal equity split arguments based solely on original idea.

tasks.goal: State willingness to defer full salary until Series A round
tasks.hint: Offer compensation flexibility to preserve runway.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered salary deferral terms until major funding milestone.

tasks.goal: Clarify approval process for company expense reimbursements over threshold
tasks.hint: Set spending limit requiring dual approval.
tasks.done_when: Learner established dual-signature approval limits for major company expenses.

tasks.goal: Discuss founder disability protection and temporary leave policy
tasks.hint: Define equity rights during extended illness.
tasks.done_when: Learner outlined terms for founder leave during medical emergency.

tasks.goal: Propose annual review of equity performance milestones
tasks.hint: Suggest reassessing role contributions periodically.
tasks.done_when: Learner suggested periodic review of co-founder performance alignment.

tasks.goal: Clarify who holds primary decision authority on product features versus sales
tasks.hint: Establish final tie-breaker roles.
tasks.done_when: Learner designated final decision authority across technical and business domains.

tasks.goal: Explain concern that taking corporate venture capital early restricts exit options
tasks.hint: Discuss strategic investor trade-offs.
tasks.done_when: Learner evaluated strategic vs financial venture investor preferences.

tasks.goal: Inquire about health insurance coverage options for early co-founders
tasks.hint: Discuss benefits package timing.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about health insurance stipend or group plan timing.

tasks.goal: Discuss open-source software license compliance for core product
tasks.hint: Ensure licensing compatibility.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified open-source licensing rules for tech stack.

tasks.goal: Propose remote work policy and equipment stipend for founders
tasks.hint: Agree on work location flexibility.
tasks.done_when: Learner established remote work and home office equipment guidelines.

tasks.goal: Clarify policy regarding family members working for or investing in startup
tasks.hint: Set arm-length transaction rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner defined governance rules regarding family involvement.

tasks.goal: Inquire about founder vesting credit for pre-incorporation development months
tasks.hint: Request retroactive vesting credit.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested vesting credit for months worked prior to formal incorporation.

tasks.goal: Discuss press release quote approval rights between co-founders
tasks.hint: Establish media spokesperson guidelines.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed press release quote approval rights between co-founders.

tasks.goal: Propose using standard Delaware C-Corp structure for investor compatibility
tasks.hint: Choose optimal corporate entity.
tasks.done_when: Learner recommended Delaware C-Corp setup for venture capital readiness.

tasks.goal: Inquire about D and O insurance coverage for board members
tasks.hint: Ask about director liability protection.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about Directors and Officers liability insurance.

tasks.goal: Confirm cloud infrastructure hosting account administration access
tasks.hint: Ensure joint access to AWS or GCP accounts.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified shared admin credentials for core cloud infrastructure.

tasks.goal: Discuss domain name and trademark ownership transfer to company
tasks.hint: Ensure brand assets belong to entity.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed domain name and trademark ownership transfer to company.

tasks.goal: Propose monthly financial reporting format for internal transparency
tasks.hint: Agree on expense tracking updates.
tasks.done_when: Learner established monthly cash flow reporting format between founders.

tasks.goal: Clarify policy on attending industry trade shows and networking events
tasks.hint: Set budget for business development travel.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed on conference attendance budget parameters.

tasks.goal: Confirm emergency communication channel for urgent operational issues
tasks.hint: Select instant messaging tool for alerts.
tasks.done_when: Learner designated primary emergency alert communication channel.

tasks.goal: Inquire about R and D tax credit eligibility for software development
tasks.hint: Ask tax accountant about research credits.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about government research and development tax incentives.

tasks.goal: Discuss company culture principles and core values definition
tasks.hint: Outline team cultural foundation.
tasks.done_when: Learner drafted foundational company values and mission statement.

tasks.goal: Confirm password manager master account access protocol
tasks.hint: Secure company digital credentials.
tasks.done_when: Learner set up shared enterprise credential security manager.

tasks.goal: Inquire about customer privacy compliance requirements like GDPR
tasks.hint: Ensure data protection readiness.
tasks.done_when: Learner reviewed user privacy legal compliance requirements.

tasks.goal: Confirm bank account signer authorization for corporate account
tasks.hint: Designate bank signatories.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified authorized signers on corporate bank account.

tasks.goal: Inquire about secondary share sale restrictions prior to initial public offering
tasks.hint: Ask about transfer restrictions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about co-founder secondary share transfer approval rules.
tasks.scene_hint: A digital clock flashes local time across global office locations.

tasks.goal: Confirm primary corporate law firm retainer terms
tasks.hint: Verify legal counsel fee structure.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed legal retainer terms with company attorney.
tasks.scene_hint: Printed organizational charts lay neatly stacked on a desk.

tasks.goal: Discuss server infrastructure scaling threshold triggers
tasks.hint: Set engineering scaling benchmarks.
tasks.done_when: Learner established cloud hosting auto-scaling budget thresholds.

tasks.goal: Confirm co-founder emergency contact escalation protocol
tasks.hint: Establish emergency contact hierarchy.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified emergency communication protocol for critical downtime.
